sam: deploybot kicked off canary for release 2026.03.21-rc3 on eu-west-1 — rolling 10% now
deploy-bot: Canary started: release=2026.03.21-rc3 env=eu-west-1 pct=10 track=canary
jin: watching latency + errors. if p95 > 400ms for 3 consecutive mins we abort :warning:
ops-lead: linking backout runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/backout-2026-03 — includes DB toggle and cache clear steps :white_check_mark:
maria: @ops-lead can we pin model-serving image to v2.9.1 before we scale? last time the floating tag caused mismatch
ops-lead: pinned registry.redwood/models:serving-v2.9.1 and prepared rollback tag rollback/2026-03-21-rc3 (see runbook step 3)
tara: runbook snippet to rollback model-serving if needed:
```
# Pause rollout
kubectl scale deploy/model-proxy --replicas=0 -n prod
# Roll back to previous image
kubectl set image deploy/model-serving model-serving=registry.redwood/models:serving-v2.9.0 -n prod
# Re-enable traffic after verification
kubectl scale deploy/model-proxy --replicas=3 -n prod
```
sam: change window until 23:00 UTC. If we backout, follow runbook and notify #incidents and @oncall-sre immediately
jin: metrics so far: p50 120ms, p95 220ms, errors 0.3% — :thumbsup:
release-bot: Canary: reached 50% traffic at 4958642040
maria: If we rollback, also revert DB flag: `UPDATE feature_flags SET enabled=false WHERE name='use_new_cache';`
ops-lead: ack — I'll coordinate DB toggle + image pin rollback. Oncall SRE, please stand by to promote fallback if we see spikes
sam: quick backout checklist (for thread): 1) pause traffic 2) pin previous image 3) revert feature flag 4) clear KV cache 5) monitor 10m and escalate if errors persist
jin: +1, also capture release-note blurb and tag commits for audit
sam: closing thread when canary reaches 100% or if we abort. thanks everyone :heart:
